name: short-drama-novel-studio
description: 本地优先、可审片、可复现、可交付的 AI 漫剧生产工作室

scripts.db:generate: echo 'Database schema generation is owned by the new HTTP server.'
scripts.db:push: echo 'Database migrations are intentionally disabled for the fresh v3 database.'
scripts.test:unit: bun test --cwd apps/desktop/electron && bun test --cwd packages/schema && bun test --cwd packages/tasks && bun test --cwd packages/ai && bun test --cwd packages/ai-legacy && bun test --cwd packages/app && bun test --cwd packages/mcp && bun test packages/db/src/v3.bun.test.ts && bun test tests/lm6 && bun run test:node
scripts.test: bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit
scripts.format: bunx prettier --write README.md package.json playwright.config.ts tests/electron tsconfig.base.json apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml apps/desktop/electron.vite.config.ts apps/desktop/electron apps/desktop/scripts apps/desktop/tsconfig*.json packages/{ai,ai-legacy,app,client,db,mcp,protocol,schema,server,tasks,ui}
scripts.format:check: bunx prettier --check README.md package.json playwright.config.ts tests/electron tsconfig.base.json apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml apps/desktop/electron.vite.config.ts apps/desktop/electron apps/desktop/scripts apps/desktop/tsconfig*.json packages/{ai,ai-legacy,app,client,db,mcp,protocol,schema,server,tasks,ui}
scripts.check:generated: bun run --filter @sdns/client check:generated && bun run --filter @sdns/ai-legacy check:generated
